server_scripts.name: Populate custom_client_full_name
Admin role assignment restriction
server_scripts.script:
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
#
# Delegated user managers may assign only these profiles.
# VitalAge Admin Master is deliberately excluded so they cannot
# create another master administrator or elevate themselves.
# ============================================================

DELEGATED_MANAGER_ROLE = "VitalAge User Manager"

ALLOWED_ROLE_PROFILES = [
    "VitalAge Branch Admin",
    "VitalAge Physician",
    "VitalAge Nutrition Specialist",
    "VitalAge Nurse",
    "VitalAge Health Coordinator",
]


# These are the roles expected to be populated by the approved
# Role Profiles. Update this list whenever the profiles change.
ALLOWED_ASSIGNED_ROLES = [
    "VitalAge Branch Admin",
    "VitalAge Physician",
    "VitalAge Nutrition Specialist",
    "VitalAge Nurse",
    "VitalAge Health Coordinator",
    "Sales Manager",
    "Sales User",
]


current_user_roles = frappe.get_roles(
    frappe.session.user
)

is_system_administrator = (
    frappe.session.user == "Administrator"
    or "System Manager" in current_user_roles
)

is_delegated_manager = (
    DELEGATED_MANAGER_ROLE in current_user_roles
)


# Do not restrict Administrator or genuine System Managers.
if not is_system_administrator and is_delegated_manager:

    # Delegated managers must never edit the special accounts.
    if doc.name in ["Administrator", "Guest"]:
        frappe.throw(
            "You are not permitted to modify this system user."
        )


    # Do not allow delegated managers to edit existing
    # System Manager accounts.
    if (
        doc.name
        and frappe.db.exists(
            "Has Role",
            {
                "parent": doc.name,
                "parenttype": "User",
                "role": "System Manager",
            },
        )
    ):
        frappe.throw(
            "You are not permitted to modify a System Manager."
        )


    # Validate selected Role Profiles.
    selected_profiles = []

    for row in doc.get("role_profiles") or []:

        profile_name = row.get("role_profile")

        if profile_name:
            selected_profiles.append(profile_name)


    for profile_name in selected_profiles:

        if profile_name not in ALLOWED_ROLE_PROFILES:
            frappe.throw(
                "You may assign only approved VitalAge "
                "Role Profiles."
            )


    # Role Profiles are expanded into individual roles by
    # Frappe before the document is saved. Validate the expanded
    # role list as well, preventing manual role escalation.
    selected_roles = []

    for row in doc.get("roles") or []:

        role_name = row.get("role")

        if role_name:
            selected_roles.append(role_name)


    for role_name in selected_roles:

        if role_name not in ALLOWED_ASSIGNED_ROLES:
            frappe.throw(
                "The role "
                + role_name
                + " cannot be assigned by a delegated "
                "user administrator."
            )

server_scripts.name: Refresh membership allocations
server_scripts.script:
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD = "custom_membership_start_date"
MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD = "custom_membership_end_date"


today = frappe.utils.getdate(
    frappe.utils.today()
)

yesterday = frappe.utils.add_days(
    today,
    -1,
)


# ============================================================
# FIND MEMBERSHIPS STARTING TODAY
# ============================================================

starting_today = frappe.db.get_all(
    "CRM Deal",
    filters={
        MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD: today,
    },
    fields=["name"],
)


# ============================================================
# FIND MEMBERSHIPS THAT ENDED YESTERDAY
#
# The allocation remains active on the end date itself and
# becomes zero on the following day.
# ============================================================

ended_yesterday = frappe.db.get_all(
    "CRM Deal",
    filters={
        MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD: yesterday,
    },
    fields=["name"],
)


# ============================================================
# BUILD UNIQUE LIST
# ============================================================

deal_names = []

for row in starting_today:

    deal_name = row.get("name")

    if deal_name and deal_name not in deal_names:
        deal_names.append(deal_name)


for row in ended_yesterday:

    deal_name = row.get("name")

    if deal_name and deal_name not in deal_names:
        deal_names.append(deal_name)


# ============================================================
# SAVE DEALS
#
# Saving triggers:
# 1. Allocation Before Validate
# 2. Counter recalculation Before Save
# ============================================================

for deal_name in deal_names:

    deal = frappe.get_doc(
        "CRM Deal",
        deal_name,
    )

    deal.save(
        ignore_permissions=True
    )


frappe.db.commit()

server_scripts.name: CRM Deal - Consultation allocation
server_scripts.script:
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
#
# Change only this allocation table when packages change.
# ============================================================

STATUS_FIELD = "status"

MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD = "custom_membership_start_date"
MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD = "custom_membership_end_date"

CONCIERGE_ENABLED_FIELD = "custom_concierge"

GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_included"
CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_included"


# Allocation by Client Case status.
#
# These values apply only while today's date is inside the
# membership period, including both the start and end dates.
#
# Concierge allocation is additionally conditional on
# custom_concierge being enabled.
STATUS_ALLOCATIONS = {
    "Monitoring": {
        "general": 1.0,
        "concierge": 2.0,
    },
    "Management": {
        "general": 6.0,
        "concierge": 6.0,
    },
}


# ============================================================
# DEFAULT ALLOCATION
# ============================================================

general_included = 0.0
concierge_included = 0.0


# ============================================================
# READ CLIENT CASE VALUES
# ============================================================

status = doc.get(STATUS_FIELD) or ""

membership_start = doc.get(
    MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD
)

membership_end = doc.get(
    MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD
)

concierge_enabled = bool(
    doc.get(CONCIERGE_ENABLED_FIELD)
)

today = frappe.utils.getdate(
    frappe.utils.today()
)


# ============================================================
# DETERMINE WHETHER MEMBERSHIP IS CURRENTLY ACTIVE
# ============================================================

membership_is_active = False

if membership_start and membership_end:

    start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_start
    )

    end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_end
    )

    if start_date <= today <= end_date:
        membership_is_active = True


# ============================================================
# APPLY STATUS ALLOCATION
# ============================================================

if membership_is_active:

    allocation = STATUS_ALLOCATIONS.get(status)

    if allocation:

        general_included = float(
            allocation.get("general") or 0
        )

        if concierge_enabled:
            concierge_included = float(
                allocation.get("concierge") or 0
            )


# ============================================================
# SET READ-ONLY FIELDS
# ============================================================

doc.set(
    GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD,
    general_included,
)

doc.set(
    CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD,
    concierge_included,
)

server_scripts.name: CRM Deal - Consultation recalculation
server_scripts.script:
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TASK_TYPE_FIELD = "custom_task_type"
TASK_DATE_FIELD = "due_date"

TASK_STATUS_FIELD = "status"
TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD = "reference_doctype"
TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD = "reference_docname"

DONE_STATUS = "Done"


MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD = "custom_membership_start_date"
MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD = "custom_membership_end_date"


GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_included"
GENERAL_USED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_used"
GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD = "custom_extra_consultations_paid"
GENERAL_REMAINING_FIELD = "custom_consultations_remaining"


CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_included"
CONCIERGE_USED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_used"
CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD = "custom_extra_concierge_paid"
CONCIERGE_REMAINING_FIELD = "custom_concierge_remaining"


GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS = {
    "Consultation": 1.0,
    "Nutrition consultation": 0.5,
}

CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS = {
    "Concierge": 1.0,
}


# ============================================================
# VALIDATE MEMBERSHIP PERIOD
# ============================================================

membership_start = doc.get(
    MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD
)

membership_end = doc.get(
    MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD
)


if membership_start and not membership_end:
    frappe.throw(
        "Membership End Date is required when "
        "Membership Start Date is set."
    )


if membership_end and not membership_start:
    frappe.throw(
        "Membership Start Date is required when "
        "Membership End Date is set."
    )


if membership_start and membership_end:

    period_start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_start
    )

    period_end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_end
    )

    if period_end_date < period_start_date:
        frappe.throw(
            "Membership End Date cannot be before "
            "Membership Start Date."
        )


# ============================================================
# DETERMINE WHETHER MEMBERSHIP IS ACTIVE TODAY
# ============================================================

membership_is_active = False

today = frappe.utils.getdate(
    frappe.utils.today()
)

if membership_start and membership_end:

    active_start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_start
    )

    active_end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_end
    )

    if (
        active_start_date
        <= today
        <= active_end_date
    ):
        membership_is_active = True


# ============================================================
# CALCULATE TASK USAGE
# ============================================================

general_used = 0.0
concierge_used = 0.0


deal_exists = False

if doc.name and frappe.db.exists("CRM Deal", doc.name):
    deal_exists = True


# Used remains a historical total for tasks whose Due Date is
# inside the recorded membership period.
if (
    deal_exists
    and membership_start
    and membership_end
):

    completed_tasks = frappe.db.get_all(
        "CRM Task",
        filters=[
            [
                TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD,
                "=",
                "CRM Deal",
            ],
            [
                TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD,
                "=",
                doc.name,
            ],
            [
                TASK_STATUS_FIELD,
                "=",
                DONE_STATUS,
            ],
            [
                TASK_DATE_FIELD,
                "between",
                [
                    membership_start,
                    membership_end,
                ],
            ],
        ],
        fields=[
            TASK_TYPE_FIELD,
        ],
    )


    for completed_task in completed_tasks:

        completed_type = completed_task.get(
            TASK_TYPE_FIELD
        ) or ""


        if completed_type in GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS:
            general_used += GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                completed_type
            ]


        if completed_type in CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS:
            concierge_used += CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                completed_type
            ]


# ============================================================
# CALCULATE BALANCES
# ============================================================

# The separate allocation script should already have set these
# two Included fields according to status and active dates.
general_included = float(
    doc.get(GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD) or 0
)

general_extra_paid = float(
    doc.get(GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD) or 0
)

concierge_included = float(
    doc.get(CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD) or 0
)

concierge_extra_paid = float(
    doc.get(CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD) or 0
)


if membership_is_active:

    general_remaining = (
        general_included
        + general_extra_paid
        - general_used
    )

    concierge_remaining = (
        concierge_included
        + concierge_extra_paid
        - concierge_used
    )

else:

    general_remaining = 0.0
    concierge_remaining = 0.0


# ============================================================
# SET CALCULATED VALUES
# ============================================================

doc.set(
    GENERAL_USED_FIELD,
    general_used,
)

doc.set(
    GENERAL_REMAINING_FIELD,
    general_remaining,
)

doc.set(
    CONCIERGE_USED_FIELD,
    concierge_used,
)

doc.set(
    CONCIERGE_REMAINING_FIELD,
    concierge_remaining,
)

server_scripts.name: CRM Task - Consultation recalculation after delete
server_scripts.script:
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TASK_TYPE_FIELD = "custom_task_type"
TASK_DATE_FIELD = "due_date"

TASK_STATUS_FIELD = "status"
TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD = "reference_doctype"
TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD = "reference_docname"

DONE_STATUS = "Done"


MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD = "custom_membership_start_date"
MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD = "custom_membership_end_date"


GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_included"
GENERAL_USED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_used"
GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD = "custom_extra_consultations_paid"
GENERAL_REMAINING_FIELD = "custom_consultations_remaining"


CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_included"
CONCIERGE_USED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_used"
CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD = "custom_extra_concierge_paid"
CONCIERGE_REMAINING_FIELD = "custom_concierge_remaining"


GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS = {
    "Consultation": 1.0,
    "Nutrition consultation": 0.5,
}

CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS = {
    "Concierge": 1.0,
}


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY CLIENT CASE
# ============================================================

deal_name = None

if doc.get(TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD) == "CRM Deal":
    deal_name = doc.get(TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD)


# ============================================================
# RECALCULATE AFTER DELETION
# ============================================================

if deal_name:

    deal_values = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Deal",
        deal_name,
        [
            MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD,
            MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD,
            GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD,
            GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD,
            CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD,
            CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD,
        ],
        as_dict=1,
    )

    if deal_values:

        membership_start = deal_values.get(
            MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD
        )

        membership_end = deal_values.get(
            MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD
        )


        # Determine whether the membership is active today.
        membership_is_active = False

        today = frappe.utils.getdate(
            frappe.utils.today()
        )

        if membership_start and membership_end:

            active_start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                membership_start
            )

            active_end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                membership_end
            )

            if (
                active_start_date
                <= today
                <= active_end_date
            ):
                membership_is_active = True


        general_used = 0.0
        concierge_used = 0.0


        # Count all remaining Done tasks inside the recorded
        # membership period.
        if membership_start and membership_end:

            completed_tasks = frappe.db.get_all(
                "CRM Task",
                filters=[
                    [
                        TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD,
                        "=",
                        "CRM Deal",
                    ],
                    [
                        TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD,
                        "=",
                        deal_name,
                    ],
                    [
                        TASK_STATUS_FIELD,
                        "=",
                        DONE_STATUS,
                    ],
                    [
                        TASK_DATE_FIELD,
                        "between",
                        [
                            membership_start,
                            membership_end,
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
                fields=[
                    TASK_TYPE_FIELD,
                ],
            )


            for completed_task in completed_tasks:

                completed_type = completed_task.get(
                    TASK_TYPE_FIELD
                ) or ""


                if completed_type in GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS:
                    general_used += GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                        completed_type
                    ]


                if completed_type in CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS:
                    concierge_used += CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                        completed_type
                    ]


        # ====================================================
        # CALCULATE BALANCES
        # ====================================================

        general_included = float(
            deal_values.get(
                GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )

        general_extra_paid = float(
            deal_values.get(
                GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )

        concierge_included = float(
            deal_values.get(
                CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )

        concierge_extra_paid = float(
            deal_values.get(
                CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )


        if membership_is_active:

            general_remaining = (
                general_included
                + general_extra_paid
                - general_used
            )

            concierge_remaining = (
                concierge_included
                + concierge_extra_paid
                - concierge_used
            )

        else:

            general_remaining = 0.0
            concierge_remaining = 0.0


        # ====================================================
        # UPDATE CLIENT CASE
        # ====================================================

        frappe.db.set_value(
            "CRM Deal",
            deal_name,
            {
                GENERAL_USED_FIELD: general_used,
                GENERAL_REMAINING_FIELD: general_remaining,
                CONCIERGE_USED_FIELD: concierge_used,
                CONCIERGE_REMAINING_FIELD: concierge_remaining,
            },
            update_modified=False,
        )

server_scripts.name: CRM Task - Consultation validation and recalculation
server_scripts.script:
# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

TASK_TYPE_FIELD = "custom_task_type"
TASK_DATE_FIELD = "due_date"

TASK_STATUS_FIELD = "status"
TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD = "reference_doctype"
TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD = "reference_docname"

DONE_STATUS = "Done"

# Notification recipient fields.
TASK_CLIENT_EMAIL_FIELD = "custom_client_email"
DEAL_EMAIL_FIELD = "email"


# ============================================================
# TASK TYPE RESTRICTIONS
#
# Task Types not included in either list are unrestricted and
# may be used with every reference DocType.
#
# Edit only these two lists when restrictions change.
# ============================================================

LEAD_ONLY_TASK_TYPES = [
    "Schedule initial consultation",
    "Schedule sample collection",
    "Contact later",
    "Discovery call",
]

DEAL_ONLY_TASK_TYPES = [
    "Consultation",
    "Nutrition consultation",
    "Concierge",
    "Sample collection",
    "Therapy",
    "Other consultation",
    "Send supplements",
    "Send probiotics",
    "Start CGM",
]


# ============================================================
# CRM DEAL MEMBERSHIP FIELDS
# ============================================================

MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD = "custom_membership_start_date"
MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD = "custom_membership_end_date"


# Eligibility flags.
NUTRITION_FLAG_FIELD = "custom_nutrition"
CONCIERGE_FLAG_FIELD = "custom_concierge"


# General consultation counters.
GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_included"
GENERAL_USED_FIELD = "custom_consultations_used"
GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD = "custom_extra_consultations_paid"
GENERAL_REMAINING_FIELD = "custom_consultations_remaining"


# Concierge consultation counters.
CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_included"
CONCIERGE_USED_FIELD = "custom_concierge_used"
CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD = "custom_extra_concierge_paid"
CONCIERGE_REMAINING_FIELD = "custom_concierge_remaining"


# ============================================================
# TASK WEIGHTS
#
# Other consultation is Deal-only, but it does not currently
# consume any quota because it is absent from these mappings.
# ============================================================

GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS = {
    "Consultation": 1.0,
    "Nutrition consultation": 0.5,
}

CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS = {
    "Concierge": 1.0,
}


# ============================================================
# CURRENT TASK VALUES
# ============================================================

task_type = doc.get(TASK_TYPE_FIELD) or ""
task_status = doc.get(TASK_STATUS_FIELD)
task_date = doc.get(TASK_DATE_FIELD)

reference_doctype = (
    doc.get(TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD) or ""
)

reference_docname = doc.get(
    TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD
)


# ============================================================
# COPY CLIENT EMAIL FROM THE LINKED DEAL
#
# Notifications can only select recipient fields directly from
# CRM Task, so the Deal email is copied into a hidden Task field.
# ============================================================

if (
    reference_doctype == "CRM Deal"
    and reference_docname
):

    deal_email = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Deal",
        reference_docname,
        DEAL_EMAIL_FIELD,
    )

    doc.set(
        TASK_CLIENT_EMAIL_FIELD,
        deal_email or "",
    )

else:

    doc.set(
        TASK_CLIENT_EMAIL_FIELD,
        "",
    )


is_consultation_task = (
    task_type == "Consultation"
    or task_type == "Nutrition consultation"
    or task_type == "Concierge"
)


new_deal_name = None

if reference_doctype == "CRM Deal":
    new_deal_name = reference_docname


# ============================================================
# VALIDATE TASK TYPE AGAINST REFERENCE DOCTYPE
# ============================================================

# Lead-only Task Types may be linked only to CRM Lead.
if (
    task_type
    and task_type in LEAD_ONLY_TASK_TYPES
    and reference_doctype != "CRM Lead"
):
    frappe.throw(
        "This Task Type is available only for Leads."
    )


# Deal-only Task Types may be linked only to CRM Deal.
if (
    task_type
    and task_type in DEAL_ONLY_TASK_TYPES
    and reference_doctype != "CRM Deal"
):
    frappe.throw(
        "This Task Type is available only for Client Cases."
    )


# ============================================================
# CONSULTATION VALIDATION
# ============================================================

deal_settings = None


# Consultation, Nutrition consultation and Concierge require
# complete membership dates on the linked Client Case.
if new_deal_name and is_consultation_task:

    deal_settings = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Deal",
        new_deal_name,
        [
            MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD,
            MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD,
            NUTRITION_FLAG_FIELD,
            CONCIERGE_FLAG_FIELD,
        ],
        as_dict=1,
    )

    if not deal_settings:
        frappe.throw(
            "The linked Client Case could not be found."
        )


    membership_start = deal_settings.get(
        MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD
    )

    membership_end = deal_settings.get(
        MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD
    )


    if not membership_start or not membership_end:
        frappe.throw(
            "Membership Start Date and Membership End Date "
            "must both be filled in on the Client Case before "
            "creating this consultation task."
        )


    start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_start
    )

    end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
        membership_end
    )


    if end_date < start_date:
        frappe.throw(
            "The Client Case has an invalid membership period. "
            "Membership End Date cannot be before "
            "Membership Start Date."
        )


    # Nutrition consultation requires Nutrition eligibility.
    if (
        task_type == "Nutrition consultation"
        and not deal_settings.get(NUTRITION_FLAG_FIELD)
    ):
        frappe.throw(
            "Nutrition consultations are not enabled for this "
            "Client Case. Enable Nutrition before saving this task."
        )


    # Concierge requires Concierge eligibility.
    if (
        task_type == "Concierge"
        and not deal_settings.get(CONCIERGE_FLAG_FIELD)
    ):
        frappe.throw(
            "Concierge consultations are not enabled for this "
            "Client Case. Enable Concierge before saving this task."
        )


# A completed consultation task must have a Due Date.
if (
    is_consultation_task
    and task_status == DONE_STATUS
    and not task_date
):
    frappe.throw(
        "A consultation date is required before this task "
        "can be marked Done."
    )


# ============================================================
# FIND OLD CLIENT CASE
#
# This allows both Client Cases to recalculate when a task is
# moved from one Client Case to another.
# ============================================================

task_exists = False
old_deal_name = None

if doc.name and frappe.db.exists("CRM Task", doc.name):

    task_exists = True

    old_link = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Task",
        doc.name,
        [
            TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD,
            TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD,
        ],
        as_dict=1,
    )

    if (
        old_link
        and old_link.get(
            TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD
        ) == "CRM Deal"
    ):
        old_deal_name = old_link.get(
            TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD
        )


# ============================================================
# BUILD LIST OF AFFECTED CLIENT CASES
# ============================================================

affected_deals = []

if old_deal_name:
    affected_deals.append(old_deal_name)

if (
    new_deal_name
    and new_deal_name not in affected_deals
):
    affected_deals.append(new_deal_name)


# ============================================================
# RECALCULATE EACH AFFECTED CLIENT CASE
# ============================================================

for deal_name in affected_deals:

    deal_values = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Deal",
        deal_name,
        [
            MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD,
            MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD,
            GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD,
            GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD,
            CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD,
            CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD,
        ],
        as_dict=1,
    )

    if deal_values:

        membership_start = deal_values.get(
            MEMBERSHIP_START_FIELD
        )

        membership_end = deal_values.get(
            MEMBERSHIP_END_FIELD
        )


        # Determine whether the membership is active today.
        membership_is_active = False

        today = frappe.utils.getdate(
            frappe.utils.today()
        )

        if membership_start and membership_end:

            active_start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                membership_start
            )

            active_end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                membership_end
            )

            if (
                active_start_date
                <= today
                <= active_end_date
            ):
                membership_is_active = True


        general_used = 0.0
        concierge_used = 0.0


        # Usage remains historical for the recorded membership
        # period, even after the membership has expired.
        if membership_start and membership_end:

            task_filters = [
                [
                    TASK_REFERENCE_DOCTYPE_FIELD,
                    "=",
                    "CRM Deal",
                ],
                [
                    TASK_REFERENCE_NAME_FIELD,
                    "=",
                    deal_name,
                ],
                [
                    TASK_STATUS_FIELD,
                    "=",
                    DONE_STATUS,
                ],
                [
                    TASK_DATE_FIELD,
                    "between",
                    [
                        membership_start,
                        membership_end,
                    ],
                ],
            ]


            # Exclude the saved version of the current task.
            # Its new unsaved values are added separately.
            if task_exists:
                task_filters.append(
                    [
                        "name",
                        "!=",
                        doc.name,
                    ]
                )


            completed_tasks = frappe.db.get_all(
                "CRM Task",
                filters=task_filters,
                fields=[
                    TASK_TYPE_FIELD,
                ],
            )


            for completed_task in completed_tasks:

                completed_type = completed_task.get(
                    TASK_TYPE_FIELD
                ) or ""


                if completed_type in GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS:
                    general_used += GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                        completed_type
                    ]


                if completed_type in CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS:
                    concierge_used += CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                        completed_type
                    ]


            # Add the current task using the new values currently
            # being saved.
            if (
                new_deal_name == deal_name
                and task_status == DONE_STATUS
                and task_date
            ):

                current_task_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                    task_date
                )

                period_start_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                    membership_start
                )

                period_end_date = frappe.utils.getdate(
                    membership_end
                )


                if (
                    period_start_date
                    <= current_task_date
                    <= period_end_date
                ):

                    if task_type in GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS:
                        general_used += GENERAL_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                            task_type
                        ]


                    if task_type in CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS:
                        concierge_used += (
                            CONCIERGE_TASK_WEIGHTS[
                                task_type
                            ]
                        )


        # ====================================================
        # CALCULATE BALANCES
        # ====================================================

        general_included = float(
            deal_values.get(
                GENERAL_INCLUDED_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )

        general_extra_paid = float(
            deal_values.get(
                GENERAL_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )

        concierge_included = float(
            deal_values.get(
                CONCIERGE_INCLUDED_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )

        concierge_extra_paid = float(
            deal_values.get(
                CONCIERGE_EXTRA_PAID_FIELD
            ) or 0
        )


        # Remaining is meaningful only while the membership
        # is currently active.
        if membership_is_active:

            general_remaining = (
                general_included
                + general_extra_paid
                - general_used
            )

            concierge_remaining = (
                concierge_included
                + concierge_extra_paid
                - concierge_used
            )

        else:

            general_remaining = 0.0
            concierge_remaining = 0.0


        # ====================================================
        # UPDATE CLIENT CASE
        # ====================================================

        frappe.db.set_value(
            "CRM Deal",
            deal_name,
            {
                GENERAL_USED_FIELD: general_used,
                GENERAL_REMAINING_FIELD: general_remaining,
                CONCIERGE_USED_FIELD: concierge_used,
                CONCIERGE_REMAINING_FIELD: concierge_remaining,
            },
            update_modified=False,
        )

Convert Lead to Customer
server_scripts.script:
# DO NOT ADD IMPORTS HERE - Frappe pre-loads 'frappe' automatically in Server Scripts

# Retrieve Lead ID
lead_id = frappe.form_dict.get("lead_id")

if not lead_id:
    frappe.throw("Lead ID is missing.")

# Load CRM Lead
lead_doc = frappe.get_doc("CRM Lead", lead_id)

# Build full name
name_parts = []

if lead_doc.first_name:
    name_parts.append(lead_doc.first_name)

if lead_doc.middle_name:
    name_parts.append(lead_doc.middle_name)

if lead_doc.last_name:
    name_parts.append(lead_doc.last_name)

full_name = " ".join(name_parts)

if not full_name:
    full_name = lead_doc.organization or "Unknown Contact"

# Search existing Contact by email
existing_contact = None

if lead_doc.email:
    existing_contact = frappe.db.exists(
        "Contact",
        {
            "email_id": lead_doc.email
        }
    )

# =========================================================
# CASE 1 — Existing Contact
# =========================================================

if existing_contact:

    # Link existing contact
    lead_doc.custom_contact = existing_contact

    # Change status
    lead_doc.status = "Converted"

    # Force version tracking
    lead_doc.flags.ignore_version = False

    # Save lead
    lead_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    frappe.db.commit()

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "status": "exists",
        "contact": existing_contact
    }

# =========================================================
# CASE 2 — Create new Contact
# =========================================================

else:

    contact = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Contact",
        "first_name": lead_doc.first_name,
        "middle_name": lead_doc.middle_name,
        "last_name": lead_doc.last_name
    })

    # Add email if exists
    if lead_doc.email:

        contact.append("email_ids", {
            "email_id": lead_doc.email,
            "is_primary": 1
        })

    # Add phone if exists
    if lead_doc.mobile_no:

        contact.append("phone_nos", {
            "phone": lead_doc.mobile_no,
            "is_primary_mobile_no": 1
        })

    # Create Contact
    contact.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    # Link Lead to Contact
    lead_doc.custom_contact = contact.name

    # Mark converted
    lead_doc.status = "Converted"

    # Force version tracking
    lead_doc.flags.ignore_version = False

    # Save Lead
    lead_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    frappe.db.commit()

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "status": "created",
        "contact": contact.name
    }
